markets.title: Will USDT market capitalization reach $200 billion by December 31, 2026?
markets.resolution_rules: This project-authored synthetic market resolves Yes if the designated daily dataset records USDT market capitalization at or above $200 billion on any day through December 31, 2026; otherwise it resolves No. A day's value is final when the next daily point is published.
